_meta.title: NOkM 6-Month Victory Action Plan
_meta.subtitle: Towards the 2027 general election
_meta.closing: One Movement. One Goal. A New Nigeria. A Better Future.
_meta.dataStatus: The four phases and their pillars come from the official action-plan circular. Individual week milestones below are the working plan and are NOT yet ratified dates — leadership sets the calendar. Nothing here should be quoted as a fixed deadline.
_meta.todo: Replace week milestones and due dates with the schedule approved by the National Coordinator.

phases.name: Foundation and structure
phases.summary: Activate the national structure, fill every vacant office, and put a working chain of command in place from national down to LGA.

phases.name: Expansion and registration
phases.summary: Drive membership registration in every state, complete ward structures, and get the PVC drive moving at scale.

phases.name: Education and consolidation
phases.summary: Train agents, run civic education through the structure, and screen and consolidate everything already built.

phases.name: Mobilisation to victory
phases.summary: Convert structure into turnout: polling-unit coverage, agent deployment, and a peaceful, well-observed election day.
